Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Algebra
Topic 2.2: Linear Equations

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Linear Equations, part of Algebra in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we solve linear equations in two unknowns? 2. How do we use linear equations in two unknowns in real life situations?
